description: TRAFFICO GIORNALIERO MEDIO 2019 SU ELEMENTO STRADALE BDTRE is a dataset listed in Italian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by GeoDati - RNDT. Attributi aggiuntivi alla componente lineare del grafo della viabilità BDTRE, relativi al Traffico Giornaliero Medio (TGM) su base annuale e ad altre informazioni legate alla mobilità veicolare, derivati dal confronto con il Grafo Supervisore Regionale (SVR) gestito da 5T srl per conto di Regione Piemonte. Coverage: GeoDati - RNDT. The portal files it under the publisher GeoDati - RNDT. Its tags are eu, grafo, impianti-di-monitoraggio-ambientale, infrastrutture, opendata. The portal shows 2026-09-19 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-it-portal.
